title: Native phone app (Android first, iOS later) that connects back to Genlock on the laptop: talk to the Assistant by dictation, get status updates, remote control
why: TJ: a native connection between genlock on the laptop and the phone, with dictation; not a 1-1 port of the Genlock UI, maybe just the Assistant

user_said: yes track the phone app as a goal

text: Pair a phone from the Mac app: a Pair phone button shows the QR and runs the bridge itself, so nobody runs node scripts (for other users)
End-to-end encrypt phone messages with a key from the QR, so whoever runs the relay cannot read them (needed before others use a shared relay)
Install the status-cards build on TJ's Pixel (phone.sh --device Pixel, from a session started after the relaunch), then have TJ check the Status cards and run Status a few times (phone-status-cards)
TJ checks the Status cards on the Pixel and runs Status a few times with several projects changed (phone-status-cards)
TJ installs 0.1.451677 from the R2 link and relaunches Genlock, then checks phone Status and a Tally status show only open sessions (session-only-status)

TJ uses the phone digest for a day; fix what he finds (live caption, auto-switch, YOU SAID quote)
